units.name: Print a parcel label
units.purpose: Guide warehouse staff through printing a parcel label
units.prerequisite_treatment: Link to the shared Access prerequisite at /parcel-labels; do not repeat sign-in instructions.
units.boundary_rationale: Printing is a distinct warehouse-staff task with its own operational procedure.

units.name: Void a parcel label
units.purpose: Guide shift supervisors through voiding and confirming a parcel label
units.prerequisite_treatment: Link to the shared Access prerequisite at /parcel-labels; do not repeat sign-in instructions.
units.boundary_rationale: Voiding is a supervisor task distinct from printing; the void procedure and confirmation remain together as required.

shared_context: Retain Access at /parcel-labels as the shared overview and canonical sign-in prerequisite: sign in to Parcel Desk. Preserve ‘Parcel Desk’ unchanged and link the overview to both task units.
duplicate_risks: Scan the package ID is an operational action present in both Print a parcel label and Void a parcel label. Retain it in each unit because it directly initiates each distinct task; reviewers should keep the task-specific continuation clear.
Access is not procedural duplication: sign-in remains canonical at /parcel-labels and both units cross-link to it.
migration_checklist: Draft the two task units with their assigned sections and audiences.
Keep /parcel-labels as the shared overview containing Access and links to both units; do not redirect it.
Add prerequisite links from both units to Access without restating sign-in steps.
Keep Void a label and Void confirmation together, including the status verification before parcel release.
Retain Parcel Desk unchanged in every retained occurrence.
Have Fulfillment Systems review the overview, both proposed units, scan-step treatment, links, localization, and routing before publication.
verification: Every supplied heading has exactly one placement.
Access is retained only in shared context and is absent from unit section lists.
Void a label and Void confirmation remain together.
The repeated scan action is identified across both task units.
Void verification remains governed by the void task.
No migration, publication, or redirect change is claimed.
open_decisions: Choose canonical URLs for the two task units.
Decide link labels and placement on /parcel-labels and within each unit.
Confirm whether localized versions require additional review beyond preserving Parcel Desk unchanged.
Confirm publication sequencing and routing ownership within Fulfillment Systems.
